source.name: WAC 246-945-990 Pharmaceutical licensing fees and renewal cycle
source.effective_basis: WSR 21-18-102, filed 8/31/21, effective 12/1/21: the most recent entry in the section's history note. Agency filings for this section list only WSR 21-12-074 and 21-18-102 as of 2026-10-02.

notes: Check every fee against the official text at the source URL; the loader also re-verifies each excerpt and amount when it runs.
Credential kind is recorded as 'license'. The WAC text calls both 'credentials'; confirm the kind against the Department of Health credential pages before approving.
Renewal recurrence of 24 months comes from subsection (1): 'renewed every two years on the practitioner's birthday'.
'Expired credential reissuance' is stored as an 'other' fee: listed for the person, never added to the cost to obtain.
Fingerprint-based background check and national certification exam are recorded as 'unknown' (not set by this WAC), so the total cost to obtain stays unconfirmed until a governing source is added.
Omitted: subsection (4)(a) fees for all pharmacy professionals (verification of credential $25.00, duplicate credential $10.00), which are services rather than steps to obtain or keep the credential.

credentials.name: Pharmacy Technician
excerpts: (1) Pharmacist, pharmacy technician, pharmacy intern, and pharmacy assistant credentials must be renewed every two years on the practitioner's birthday as provided in chapter 246-12 WAC.
(c) Pharmacy technician: Initial credential $140.00; Renewal 140.00; Late renewal penalty 70.00; Expired credential reissuance 70.00
